$comment: The CMS is this file. See README.md — adding a product is one entry in `items`. `shape` also fixes the canonical orientation (the engine never rotates); `skin.light`/`skin.dark` are root-relative WebPs under /skins/ laid across the whole piece, and an empty string falls back to the accent-fill placeholder; `iconAt` is a [cx, cy] cell of that shape, optionally [cx, cy, ax, ay] to nudge inside the cell; `face` names a preset from src/lib/content.ts and anchors it the same way — a one-eyed preset takes `at`, a two-eyed one takes `at` as the midpoint plus an optional `gap`, or both anchors as `at`/`at2`; `motion` names a personality preset from src/lib/content.ts; `noRef: true` keeps `?ref=aix4u` off a product's rendered link (DESIGN §13.3 — store pages dislike stranger params). Pieces carry no name text — the name lives in the info panel (DESIGN §3.2).

items.name: Meikyu
items.tagline: Deduce the daily dungeon in six tries
items.description: Five residents are hiding in today's dungeon. You have six tries to place them.

items.name: RayTally
items.description: A daily feed that collects the opportunities lighting up right now — watching trends and new launches, harvesting product ideas you can actually build.

items.name: Yomoru
items.tagline: Start reading where the anime left off
items.description: Finished the anime? Yomoru maps every season to its source manga or light novel and names the exact volume, edition and publisher to pick up next — organised by broadcast season, with a timetable of what is airing.

items.name: Pluck
items.tagline: Pluck the subject, drop the background
items.description: Native Mac app that lifts subjects out of photos entirely on-device — three cutout engines from instant to hair-fine, plus a scriptable CLI for agents and batch work. Free, open source, no cloud.

items.name: AHR999 Dataset
items.tagline: The Bitcoin AHR999 index, as open data
items.description: Open dataset and dashboard for the AHR999 Bitcoin accumulation index; JSON + CSV, updated daily by CI.

items.name: X2Markdown
items.tagline: Right-click any page into clean Markdown
items.description: Chrome extension that converts the visible page (or selection) into clean Markdown via right-click; dedicated extraction for x.com posts and articles; local-only processing.

items.name: Health Analyst
items.tagline: Apple Health reports, private and agent-ready
items.description: Two-stage CLI and agent skill: parses Apple Health exports locally into structured insights, then renders narrative HTML reports with SVG charts.
